entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a brand-new ORIGINAL production PNG game UI asset from scratch, with NO reference image: the FRONT FRAME ONLY of a fictional 1993 desktop VGA computer monitor. Design a unique Larchfield Business Machines county-office monitor. The design should feel like real everyday 1993 beige computer hardware: warm ivory/putty ABS plastic, a clean subtly squared rectangular outer silhouette, softly eased moulded corners, shallow recessed neutral dark-grey inner bezel, mild age and handling marks, restrained plastic grain. The bottom bezel is STRAIGHT and continuous across the full monitor width, with NO protruding or hanging control pod. Give it its own distinctive original layout: a small simple rectangular recessed grey power button plus tiny green LED at LOWER LEFT, a modest plain embossed LARCHFIELD wordmark near that left corner, and a pair of small vertical recessed brightness/contrast thumbwheels at LOWER RIGHT. Thin unobtrusive horizontal ventilation slots are moulded into the outer left/right bezel; no big central grille. Leave the stretchable central portions of the top and bottom bezel simple and unmarked. No metal screw heads, no bolts, no military styling, no rust, no olive paint, no brass, no exposed industrial frame, no glowing orange square, no Fallout/RobCo design or symbols, no steampunk. Do not reproduce the proportions, hanging lower panel, vent arrangement or controls of any fictional Fallout terminal.
Asset constraints: ONE front-on orthographic perfectly level frame only, about 16:10 aspect ratio, target canvas 1600 by1000 pixels; outer casing fills the canvas with a small transparent margin. The large screen opening is nearly rectangular with modest rounded corners, approximately x=9% to91%, y=11% to84% of the canvas. The entire screen opening MUST be genuinely transparent alpha, including all the interior: NO glass, screen image, scanlines, reflection, text, black fill or white fill in the opening. Exterior outside the casing is also transparent. This is an overlay frame through which the game will draw its own separate glass and live text. No stand, monitor depth, visible side view, keyboard, cables, room or drop shadow. Subtle believable early-1990s painted game-asset shading, not a product photo, no glossy modern surfaces. ONE original monitor frame, no variants, no scene, no screenshot, no extra artwork.

Use case: game-asset. Generate ONE seamless-looking rectangular CRT SCREEN GLASS BACKGROUND texture for the live text area of a fictional 1993 computer terminal game UI. This is the BACKGROUND ONLY, not a screenshot and not a monitor. Canvas approximately 16:10, fill every pixel edge-to-edge. Neutral monochrome grayscale only, near-black charcoal (not green or blue); the runtime will tint this texture green, golden sand, aquamarine or purple. Clearly visible fine horizontal CRT raster scanlines across the ENTIRE image, evenly spaced continuous thin dark lines alternating with faintly lit gray phosphor rows, around 200 to250 horizontal rows over the image height. Very dark at the edges, a soft subtle phosphor glow in the central glass, a faint broad diffuse reflection toward the upper-right like a slightly curved old CRT tube, with ample uniform dark space to preserve bright live text readability. Maximum brightness restrained dark gray, approximately RGB45 or lower, no white hotspot, no eye-straining light band. No text of any kind, no numbers, no symbols, no logo, no frame, no monitor casing, no buttons, no bezel, no perspective, no photographic room reflections, no moire, no vertical RGB stripes, no random snow/static, no strong scratches. The horizontal raster should be unmistakably visible at thumbnail size while remaining a calm low-contrast background. The image itself is fully opaque. ONE empty glass texture only.

history.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Generate ONE production raster UI asset: the FRONT BEZEL / FRAME ONLY of a worn early-1990s CRT computer monitor, taking the provided image as a visual style reference for its dark olive industrial plastic, rounded tube rim, chunky layered moulding, subtle scuffs, recessed lower ventilation slots and small square amber power button at LOWER RIGHT. Original fictional 1993 county-office hardware, no Fallout/RobCo branding or franchise wording. IMPORTANT deliverable: a PNG with genuinely transparent alpha in the ENTIRE LARGE SCREEN OPENING and in the exterior outside the casing. The screen must be an EMPTY HOLE through the asset: absolutely NO glass, no screen colour, no scanlines, no text, no reflection, no black fill, no white fill in that hole. Interior must be completely alpha-zero. Keep the screen opening almost rectangular, with modest rounded corners, straight edges and a clearly defined inner lip, so live text can render through it. Front orthographic view, perfectly level, symmetrical outer frame, NO perspective or visible sides, no monitor stand, no keyboard, no environment. Wide horizontal canvas about 16:10, casing fills nearly the whole canvas with only a narrow transparent margin. The hole should run approximately from x=8% to92%, y=9% to82%; bottom bezel is thicker for vents and the amber square switch near the right. Keep the central stretchable portions of the left/top/right edges simple continuous moulded strips, with all distinctive hardware details at the corners or in the bottom bezel. Subtle realistic painted-plastic texture like the reference, crisp game UI rendering, restrained 1993 pixel/painted game-art character, readable geometry, muted dark military olive/charcoal, no glossy modern sci-fi metal, no glaring scratches, no green screen baked in, no drop shadow outside the asset. No lettering except a very tiny unobtrusive POWER engraving if necessary. ONE frame only, no alternate views or variants.
history.status: Retired; not used as the base for the 1993 casing.
